cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep hold of the page too. I'll follow your finger. No need to ask why I'm taking so long.

mechanism: A sets conditions for a helper reading a letter and directs physical support while declining to explain why the task has become difficult.
confusable: D98 keeps someone until able to face a next step alone; D97 asks shared carrying of the current burden without naming its weight.
comparison: Controlled shared reading differs from delegating an anniversary cancellation.
seedUse: Retain D97-b ordinary-face condition and B side-by-side proposal becoming page-holding and finger-following help.
